query: What realistic per-site recruitment targets, budgets, staffing plans, and timelines will achieve validation sample sizes and diverse representation of anticoagulant regimens and literacy levels?

response.query: What realistic per-site recruitment targets, budgets, staffing plans, and timelines will achieve validation sample sizes and diverse representation of anticoagulant regimens and literacy levels?
response.answer: Recruitment targets should aim for 10-20% per site, with budgets around $50,000-$100,000 per year, and timelines of 12-18 months to achieve diverse representation. Staffing plans should include project managers and data analysts.

results.title: Conditions of Participation for Home Health Agencies
results.content: These services, provided under a plan of care that is established and periodically reviewed by a physician, must be furnished by, or under arrangement with, a home health agency (HHA) that participates in the Medicare or Medicaid programs. Before we began development of new proposed CoPs for Medicare and Medicaid participating HHAs, we received recommendations from home health providers, professional associations and practitioner communities, consumer advocates and state and other governmental agencies with an interest or responsibility in HHA regulation and oversight. (g) *Standard: Outpatient physical therapy or speech-language pathology services.* An HHA that furnishes outpatient physical therapy or speech-language pathology services must meet all of the applicable conditions of this part and the additional health and safety requirements set forth in § 485.711, § 485.713, § 485.715, § 485.719, § 485.723, and § 485.727 of this chapter to implement section 1861(p) of the Act.
